payload.friendly_name: Charter Pack level declared in pack.yaml
payload.purpose_context: Charter Packs (built-in, org, project) are recognised today only by where they are wired in and which files they happen to contain, so a mis-placed pack is discovered through a downstream failure rather than refused by name. This mission makes every pack declare its level and layout in pack.yaml, unifies the pack-tier/provenance vocabulary under one owner, and adds the core tooling needed to vendor the built-in pack from the open-packs repository.
payload.purpose_tldr: Every Charter Pack declares its level in pack.yaml, and core gains the tooling to vendor the built-in pack from open-packs.

payload.wp_title: Vendoring tooling — regenerate-graph --pack-root, requires_core checker, clean-tree level-aware digest
Level load-refusals (MISMATCH/MISSING), validate branch-on-level, and the pack-layout resolution seam
Upgrade migration — backfill pack.yaml (pack_level project) for existing project packs
Provenance respell (builtin→built-in) unified on kernel.pack_tiers + tier-token gate extension (ISOLATED lane)
Fold ADR 2026-10-11-2, update docs/glossary/CHANGELOG, finalize descriptor diagram, close
In-repo descriptors (built-in += pack_level; new internal pack.yaml) + authored-field gate update + manifest regen
